SETTINGS

GAMEPLAY & MODES

When Touchscreen Controls Only is enabled, keyboard, mouse-look, and controller gameplay inputs are disabled. Toggle RUN and automatic chest opening are switched on automatically when you enable touch mode; you can change either option afterward.

AUDIO

CONTROLLER

Controller help: D-pad up/down selects settings, left/right changes sliders or toggles switches, A / Cross selects, and B / Circle closes. PS4 controller detection depends on browser and operating-system Gamepad API support; try connecting by USB or Bluetooth and pressing a controller button before launching the game.
